verdict.rationale: Fenwick offers client-facing technology, including a trademark extranet, AI review tools and Fenwick Labs "web services", so a documented public API is a fair question. However, no evidence shows any public, documented API. Probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and the extranet and dashboards are described only as interactive UIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
